newsitem.title: INDIA: Rising India cotton stocks, low demand hurt prices.
newsitem.headline: Rising India cotton stocks, low demand hurt prices.

text.p: Indian cotton prices fell on Tuesday triggered by rising new crop arrivals and low demand, dealers said.

In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan fell by 300/400 rupees to 13,200/13,400 rupees per candy (355.56 kg). Bengal-deshi ready delivery eased by 5/10 rupees to 840/860 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while November delivery fell by 20 to 880/900 rupees.
The Bombay cotton market will be closed on Wednesday for the birth anniversary of India's founder, Mahatma Gandhi.
